What it checks / can detect: Session reference: output/setup normalization; separates general output error from MLC/model effects.
Primary evaluation: Absolute dose/MU or normalized reference; no MLC interpretation until reference is stable.
Recommended use: Every FullPackage measurement session; annual/post-service/model QA.
Notes: Do not tune Leaf Offset or MLC model if 10x10 reference is out.

What it checks / can detect: Global/effective Leaf Offset, hot/cold junctions, bank asymmetry, isolated leaf-row defects.
Primary evaluation: Profiles through both junctions; junction peak/trough relative to adjacent plateaus; bank/leaf-row pattern. Gamma is secondary.
Recommended use: Annual MLC-model check; after MLC calibration/service; troubleshooting.
Recommended energy coverage: Annual: all 4. Post-service: affected/reference energy minimum; all energies after model/hardware change.
Source / basis: Elekta Monaco MLC Parameter Adjustment; MPPG 5.b
Notes: Establish local junction limits from accepted baseline and sensitivity tests, not a universal gamma pass rate.

What it checks / can detect: Dynamic effective gap / Leaf Offset; dose effect of moving leaves; supports Leaf Transmission assessment.
Primary equipment: PinPoint 3D or suitable ion chamber + phantom
Primary evaluation: Absolute low-gradient point dose vs TPS plus profile; optionally DMLC1/10x10 ratio to suppress output drift.
Recommended use: Annual all-energy MLC-model check; post-service; dynamic-MLC troubleshooting.
Recommended energy coverage: Annual: all 4. Post-service: affected energies; all 4 after model/transmission change.
Program mapping: MLC-X1; supports MLC-M2 and MLC-A2 diagnosis
Source / basis: Elekta Monaco MLC Parameter Adjustment; MPPG 5.b/8.b
Notes: Point-dose target ≤2% where measurement uncertainty and low-gradient placement support it.

What it checks / can detect: Repeated segment junction behaviour; global Leaf Offset; systematic hot/cold abutments; leaf-row dependence.
Primary evaluation: Sequence of seven junctions: amplitude, periodicity, symmetry and baseline trend; gamma only as map.
Recommended use: Annual; after MLC calibration/service; confirm 3ABUT findings.
Recommended energy coverage: Annual: all 4; post-service/reference energy as minimum.
Source / basis: Elekta Monaco MLC Parameter Adjustment; MPPG 5.b
Notes: Do not tune offset using 7SegA alone; reconcile with DMLC behaviour.

What it checks / can detect: MLC transmission-dominant regions, Leaf Offset contribution, interleaf/tongue-and-groove spatial pattern.
Primary evaluation: Separate predefined ROIs: MLC-only transmission, junction/offset and groove/interleaf regions; profiles. Do not use one global gamma as sole result.
Recommended use: Annual all-energy MLC-model check; after leaf/BLD/model/transmission changes; troubleshooting.
Recommended energy coverage: Annual: all 4 because transmission is energy dependent.
Source / basis: Elekta Monaco MLC Parameter Adjustment; MPPG 5.b
Notes: Does not replace direct closed/open transmission measurement of MLC-A2.

What it checks / can detect: Small-field output/model, leaf-tip/penumbra sensitivity and field-size-dependent error.
Primary evaluation: TRS-483-corrected output factor vs TPS; profile/field size as secondary.
Recommended use: Annual all-energy small-field QA; after beam-model/MLC/head changes.
Notes: Use the existing MLC-A1 acceptance criterion, not array gamma.

What it checks / can detect: Static gap-width dependence, small-aperture dose model, Leaf Offset/leaf-tip sensitivity.
Secondary equipment: 1600 SRS or film for detailed central subregions
Primary evaluation: Predefined ROI dose for 1, 2, 3, 4 cm gaps; signed TPS difference as a vector versus gap width.
Recommended use: Annual all-energy model check; troubleshooting when small gaps fail.
Notes: Use local commissioning-derived limits; 1-cm region may require detector/grid-specific interpretation.

What it checks / can detect: Same gap-width challenge during leaf motion; isolates dynamic MLC effects from static geometry.
Primary evaluation: ROI dose vector plus W/S ratio for each gap; spatial pattern and profiles.
Recommended use: Annual all-energy model/delivery check; after MLC dynamic service; troubleshooting.
Notes: 1234S good + 1234W bad points toward dynamic delivery/model rather than static aperture geometry.

What it checks / can detect: Small-gap behaviour with simultaneous MLC motion and gantry rotation; arc synchronization stress.
Primary equipment: Octavius 4D with 1500 or 1600 SRS as appropriate
Secondary equipment: Film/EPID only for selected static-style diagnostics
Primary evaluation: ROI dose vector; V/W ratio by gap; spatial failure clusters. Gamma is diagnostic.
Recommended use: Annual all-energy VMAT/model check; after TCS/MLC/gantry/dose-rate service; troubleshooting.
Program mapping: MLC-X1 / VMAT diagnostic; does NOT replace VMAT-M1 DDC
Notes: If W is good but V is bad, investigate gantry/dose-rate/arc coupling.

What it checks / can detect: Integrated MLC + gantry + dose rate + jaw/BLD + TPS calculation/delivery under complex modulation.
Primary equipment: PinPoint 3D + Unidos for primary point dose
Primary evaluation: Primary: low-gradient point dose vs TPS. Secondary: absolute/global gamma map, signed/local dose differences, pattern localization.
Recommended use: Standardized FullPackage complex reference; annual all energies and post-service. May be added to monthly rotation after local baseline validation.
Recommended energy coverage: Annual: all 4; monthly only if adopted as standardized VMAT-M4 reference/rotation.
Notes: Do not automatically replace the existing validated clinical reference plan; use as standardized adjunct unless formally adopted.

What it checks / can detect: Array setup/response and broad beam profile sanity check before interpreting complex FullPackage maps.
Primary evaluation: Profile symmetry/OAF and consistency with baseline/TPS.
Recommended use: At FullPackage array baseline sessions; annual/profile/post-service checks.
Recommended energy coverage: Measure for tested energy when array setup/profile is being verified.
Notes: Not an Agility-specific leaf-position test.

Class: Arc with essentially fixed stepped aperture
What it checks / can detect: Separates gantry/angular delivery contribution from MLC-motion contribution in the 1234 family.
Primary evaluation: Compare A with S and V; angular-sector dose pattern.
Recommended use: Troubleshooting when 1234V fails; post-gantry service if needed.
Recommended energy coverage: Affected VMAT energy or selected reference energy.
Notes: A bad together with V shifts suspicion toward gantry/angular/couch/detector rather than leaf motion alone.

What it checks / can detect: Composite dynamic delivery of multiple gap/active-length components; sequencing/synchronization challenge.
Primary evaluation: Combined distribution vs component DMLC1/2/3; profiles and ROI trend.
Recommended use: Post-service/troubleshooting after DMLC1-3 characterization.
Recommended energy coverage: Affected energy; all energies only for model investigation.
Notes: Useful after individual DMLC components are understood.

What it checks / can detect: Step-and-shoot response across progressively changing aperture width.
Primary evaluation: Dose/profile versus aperture width; baseline pattern.
Recommended use: Troubleshooting SMLC/model; post-model change if SMLC used.
Recommended energy coverage: Affected energy or all energies for model work.
Notes: Pair with VW07T.

What it checks / can detect: Dynamic analogue of VW07S; trajectory/interpolation and changing-gap delivery.
Primary evaluation: Dynamic/static comparison and local profile/dose differences.
Recommended use: Troubleshooting dynamic MLC/model.
Recommended energy coverage: Affected energy or all energies for model work.
Notes: VW07S good + VW07T bad points toward dynamic delivery/model.

What it checks / can detect: Y diaphragm/field-defining element position and model with minimal MLC-shape complexity.
Primary evaluation: Field-edge position/width and dose profile versus baseline/TPS.
Recommended use: After Agility BLD/Y-diaphragm service; targeted troubleshooting.
Recommended energy coverage: Affected energy; reference energy minimum for pure geometry.
Notes: Not a primary Leaf Offset field.

What it checks / can detect: Integrated step-and-shoot complexity after basic MLC model parameters are accepted.
Primary evaluation: Primary low-gradient point dose plus distribution/profile review.
Recommended use: Only if SMLC IMRT is clinically used; final modality-specific model check.
Recommended energy coverage: All energies used for SMLC IMRT.
Source / basis: Elekta Monaco MLC Parameter Adjustment; MPPG 5.b
Notes: Do not use if SMLC is not a clinical delivery modality.

What it checks / can detect: Integrated dynamic MLC complexity after DMLC1/basic model checks.
Primary evaluation: Primary low-gradient point dose plus distribution/profile review.
Recommended use: Only if DMLC/sliding-window IMRT is clinically used.
Recommended energy coverage: All energies used for DMLC IMRT.
Source / basis: Elekta Monaco MLC Parameter Adjustment; MPPG 5.b
Notes: Use after basic synthetic fields, not as the only model validation.

What it checks / can detect: Bridges 10x10 reference to small-field regime; field-size dependent output/profile bias.
Primary evaluation: Output factor and profile versus TPS/baseline.
Recommended use: Troubleshooting small-field transition; TPS Section 5 support.
Recommended energy coverage: All energies when investigating field-size dependence.
Notes: Not needed as separate calendar QA if existing OF/profile program covers it.

What it checks / can detect: Direction/active-length/group dependence beyond DMLC1.
Primary evaluation: Relative dose/profile versus DMLC1 and baseline.
Recommended use: Troubleshooting when DMLC1 result is non-uniform or direction-dependent.

What it checks / can detect: Central/shorter active-region dynamic behaviour and distance dependence.
Primary evaluation: Relative dose/profile versus DMLC1/2 and baseline.
Recommended use: Troubleshooting dynamic MLC.

What it checks / can detect: Localizes specific subset of 7SegA junctions.
Primary evaluation: Individual junction profiles and comparison with 7Seg4/7SegA.
Recommended use: Troubleshooting failed 7SegA.

What it checks / can detect: Localizes complementary subset of 7SegA junctions.
Primary evaluation: Individual junction profiles and comparison with 7Seg3/7SegA.
Recommended use: Troubleshooting failed 7SegA.

What it checks / can detect: Gantry rotation + angular output/couch/detector effects without meaningful MLC modulation.
Primary evaluation: Integrated/sector dose and angular trend versus baseline.
Recommended use: Troubleshooting VMAT/angular issue; post-gantry service.
Notes: Not a complete VMAT DDC test.

What it checks / can detect: Same as ARC01 for another angular sector.
Primary evaluation: Sector dose versus baseline and ARC01/03.
Recommended use: Troubleshooting angular-sector dependence.

What it checks / can detect: Same as ARC01 for another angular sector.
Primary evaluation: Sector dose versus baseline and ARC01/02.
Recommended use: Troubleshooting angular-sector dependence.

What it checks / can detect: Angular output, couch attenuation/model and detector angular response.
Primary evaluation: Dose/OAF versus gantry-0 baseline; couch-path interpretation.
Recommended use: Dosimetry/couch troubleshooting; post-gantry/head/couch work.
Recommended energy coverage: Affected energy; annual only if used as local angular dataset.
Notes: Not an Agility leaf-position test.

What it checks / can detect: Couch attenuation + oblique angular output/detector response.
Primary evaluation: Dose versus angular/couch baseline.
Recommended use: Couch/angular troubleshooting.

What it checks / can detect: Lateral angular output reference with different couch path.
Primary evaluation: Dose/OAF versus baseline.
Recommended use: Angular troubleshooting.

What it checks / can detect: Angular output symmetry / couch-detector separation by angle.
Primary evaluation: Dose versus baseline and complementary angles.
Recommended use: Angular troubleshooting.

What it checks / can detect: Complementary angular reference for symmetry/trend.
Primary evaluation: Dose versus baseline and G305/other angles.
Recommended use: Angular troubleshooting.

What it checks / can detect: Detector centering/rotation/profile sanity; primarily validates measurement setup rather than Agility.
Primary equipment: Octavius/other array according to local setup
Primary evaluation: Profile symmetry and centering.
Recommended use: Only when establishing/checking array setup for FullPackage.
Recommended energy coverage: One representative energy usually sufficient for setup.
Notes: Do not count as independent MLC QA.

What it checks / can detect: Angular setup/centering response at one lateral angle; originally device-setup oriented.
Primary equipment: 3D array / local phantom if geometry is compatible
Primary evaluation: Relative/symmetry check versus DLTS2/3.
Recommended use: Only if validated for your Octavius setup; otherwise N/A.
Notes: May be omitted if not useful with the local Octavius geometry.

What it checks / can detect: Central/reference member of DLTS setup trio.
Primary evaluation: Reference relative dose/profile.
Recommended use: Only if validated for local setup.

What it checks / can detect: Complementary lateral setup/angular response.
Primary evaluation: Relative/symmetry check versus DLTS1/2.
Recommended use: Only if validated for local setup.
